name: Shirmani Employment Income Status Bridge
purpose: Connect employment/work lifecycle states to income evidence without inventing hiring, completion, payment, salary, or income.

transition_requirements.AVAILABLE: Publication of an opportunity or service surface; no engagement or income is implied.
transition_requirements.OPEN: A real application, enquiry, order, or engagement route is available and its conditions are stated.
transition_requirements.CONFIRMED: External client, customer, hiring party, order, or contract evidence is required.
transition_requirements.COMPLETED: Completion/delivery and acceptance evidence is required; this does not itself prove payment.
transition_requirements.PAID: Payment evidence is required; amount must come from evidence and must not be invented.
transition_requirements.NOT_VERIFIED: Use when relevant information exists but the evidence required for the claimed state is insufficient.

integrity_rules: No fabricated employment or client confirmation.
No fabricated salary, fee, sales, payment, or income.
PAID does not by itself prove accounting reconciliation or bank settlement.
A public income total must be derived from evidence-backed ledger records.
AI-generated text, certificates, profiles, testimonials, or portfolio descriptions are not transaction evidence.
Identity, contract interpretation, acceptance, payment disputes, refunds, reversals, and liability require human review.
